scope: One bounded independent author-QA review plus targeted corrections; not the lead's deferred whole-branch or gate review

findings.problem: Successive proposal replies could overwrite their active goal ancestry
findings.resolution: Bounded sender goal ancestry retained separately from decline/reply metadata; reaffirmation correlation retained.

findings.problem: A full fallback with different await-word terms could neither obtain a valid go nor conceal its readiness until reported
findings.resolution: Received switch/readiness papers choose effective terms; go carries plan correlation and is checked on arrival.

findings.problem: An unjoined stronger reinforcement could displace the condition's command position
findings.resolution: Use canonical joined headquarters, joined colocated strength and the same retreat-line origin; paired controls.

findings.problem: Alternative-goal searches were bounded but absent from search telemetry
findings.resolution: Count and report auxiliary searches under the existing cap.

findings.problem: Extreme existing tolerance values could produce a negative superiority threshold
findings.resolution: Clamp negative tolerance and short-circuit at or above1000; strict superiority boundary, with no new default.

findings.problem: Fresh objections to reaffirmed or conflict-kept goals did not generate proposals
findings.resolution: Separate bounded PlanChallenge and explicit active-authority correlation; active plan identity/clocks preserved; stale reply controls.
